sections.title: About this species
sections.text: A heavy-bodied, nonvenomous boa that subdues prey by constriction. Its appearance varies between local populations, and it can look similar to Boa constrictor.

sections.title: Where it lives
sections.text: Native populations occur from Mexico through Central America into northwestern Colombia, including some coastal islands. This describes the species in the wild, not the origin of an individual animal.

sections.title: In the wild
sections.text: Young boas may forage in trees and shrubs. As they become larger and heavier, they spend more time on the ground.
